thread:
alex_sales: FYI: Acme confirmed the POC termination window. Need a short, customer-ready runbook for teardown: keys, pools, VPC, logs, and what we archive vs destroy. Who owns what?

mike_se: I'll take hosted keys + dedicated pools. High level: revoke keys, export logs, drain + scale down pools, clear caches.

sophie_security: Add a pre-check: any open compliance/legal holds? If yes, stop teardown and escalate. If no, proceed with retention rules.

jess_ops: Ops will handle VPC, snapshots, and final cleans. I'll draft exact commands and time windows.

alex_sales: Make it copy/paste ready so I can include in the customer email. Keep it short.

mike_se: Hosted API keys (owner: mike_se)
- Immediately revoke all POC API keys and rotate any shared service tokens.
- Export request logs (most recent 90 days) to s3://redwood-exports/acme-poc/logs/YYYYMMDD/ and attach in ticket.
- Add an audit entry: "POC teardown - hosted keys revoked".
Example curl (admin):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys/revoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"key_id":"ak:acme:poc:01","reason":"poc-sunset"}'
```

Dedicated GPU pool (owner: mike_se)
- Set pool to "drain" so no new jobs land.
- Monitor active sessions; wait up to 20 minutes for in-flight to finish, otherwise force-kill stale sessions.
- Export metrics + KV cache snapshot to the same S3 prefix.
- Scale pool replicas to zero and mark pool record as "decommissioned:pending-delete".
Command snippets: ``redwoodctl pools set-drain --pool-id pool-acme-01`` then ``redwoodctl pools scale --pool-id pool-acme-01 --replicas 0``

sophie_security: Retention and deletion policy (owner: sophie_security)
- PII-containing records: remove within 7 days unless legal hold.
- Model inputs/outputs: default 30-day retention; move to cold archive for 90 days only if requested by ML team.
- Audit logs: retain 365 days in WORM storage.
- Produce a Deletion Manifest (owner = sophie_security) listing deleted object keys + SHA256 hashes + deletion timestamps, store manifest in s3://redwood-exports/acme-poc/manifests/.

jess_ops: VPC / private connectivity (owner: jess_ops)
- Schedule traffic drain window and confirm zero active connections.
- Delete peering connection and BGP routes once drained.
- Snapshot attached volumes if retention required, otherwise securely wipe volumes.
- Revoke temporary firewall/NAT rules and remove floating IPs.
Internal commands: ``redwoodctl vpc peering delete --id pcx-zzzz --confirm`` and ``redwoodctl volumes snapshot --tag acme-poc --dest s3://redwood-exports/acme-poc/volumes/``

mike_se: Caches & routing (owner: mike_se)
- Flush any POC-scoped KV/prefix caches to prevent leakage into other tenants.
- Remove any routing rules or canaries referencing Acme model variants.
CLI: ``redwoodctl cache flush --scope acme-poc``

sophie_security: Legal hold flow:
- alex_sales -> confirm with legal immediately. If hold: mark resources with tag "legalhold" and copy artifacts to restricted-bucket with IAM whitelist.
- If no hold: proceed with deletion schedule and generate manifest.

alex_sales: Legal confirmed: no hold. Proceed under standard retention. I'll cc the customer with the timeline.

jess_ops: Proposed schedule (all times PDT):
- Thu 09:00: revoke hosted keys + export logs (mike_se).
- Thu 10:00: drain GPU pool (mike_se).
- Thu 11:00: snapshot volumes or mark for wipe (jess_ops).
- Thu 12:00: flush caches + remove routing canaries (mike_se).
- Fri 23:00 UTC: final deletion sweep (decomm-bot).

mike_se: I'll post S3 links after each export. Will also attach quick verification steps for the customer (sample curl showing 401 after revoke).

jess_ops: decomm-bot please create final-sweep job: steps = [revoke-keys, export-logs, drain-pools, snapshot-or-wipe, flush-cache, delete-objects, upload-manifest]. Run window: 2026-04-10T23:00:00Z.

decomm-bot: Job created: acme-poc-sunset-2026-04-10 (id: sweep-2026-04-10-901). Executor: ops-runner-3. Will post status in this thread when complete. :robot_face:

alex_sales: Awesome. Once the manifests and S3 links are posted I'll update the customer and close the POC ticket. Thanks everyone.
